guide.biology: Salty water draws water out of cells, so most microbes dislike it, while a few salt-loving kinds do best in it.
guide.rules: Adds salt that dissolves and diffuses and never decays; only sampling or clean water replacement removes it. Salinity is the amount of salt in a cell. Most species do best at 0 to 0.20 (algae 0 to 0.15), and suitability fades to zero within 0.20 above a species' range. Brinecoil prefers 0.4 to 0.8. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: Paint a salty strip across the dish and see which species stay on each side.
